audit: PUMS WKHP hurdle/typed-concept audit (Hurdle Audit Tests 1-2 of 04-hurdle-test-and-audit)

verdicts.zeros_never_in_active_branch: PASS: 0 zeros among 6,727 employed records across both states (binomial 95% upper bound ~5.5e-4)
verdicts.wkhp_zero_equals_nonworkers: FAIL as stated: zeros are exclusively non-employed (P(WKHP=0|emp)=0) but only 84.2% (WY) / 76.5% (DC) of non-employed are zero — WKHP is a past-12-months variable, ESR is current employment; ~16-24% of currently-non-employed worked earlier in the year. The clean typed variable is state = worked-at-all-in-past-12-months, extent = WKHP|worked (hurdle then partly definitional; non-trivial evidence is strict positivity + spread inside employment)
verdicts.cross_state_shift: PRESENT: mean hours 39.48 (WY) vs 40.45 (DC); zero fraction 0.375 vs 0.251
